label: Main theorems: RH and GRH
gloss: The final statements of the Riemann Hypothesis and GRH for Dirichlet L-functions, and their derivation from the main argument.

label: Build settings and Hermitian adjoint
gloss: Project-wide settings for instance search and simp, plus the adjoint of a matrix for the Hermitian dot product.

label: Landherr's theorem and Hasse principle
gloss: A local-to-global principle for hermitian spaces over number fields: a unitary cocycle trivial everywhere locally is trivial.

label: Adeles of number fields
gloss: Basic theory of adeles of a number field: topology, characters, Haar measure, and approximation by field elements.

label: Automorphic forms on unitary groups
gloss: Automorphic and algebraic modular forms on adelic unitary groups: cuspidality, rapid decay, inner products and Hecke eigenforms.

label: Hecke operators and class sums
gloss: Hecke operators on spaces of forms of a given level, and class sums written as integrals over arithmetic quotients.

label: Quotient measures and unfolding
gloss: Measures on quotients of groups by subgroups, and the unfolding method that turns integrals over quotients into sums.

label: Adelic reduction theory
gloss: Geometry of numbers for hermitian lattices over number fields, giving finite volume of the arithmetic quotient of unitary groups.

label: Simple trace formula, unitary groups
gloss: A simple trace formula for unitary groups, used to compare traces of Hecke operators on forms for different hermitian spaces.

label: Adelic unitary groups
gloss: Unitary groups of hermitian spaces over CM fields at adelic points, with levels, lattices and approximation results.

label: Witt's theorem and Iwasawa decomposition
gloss: Extending isometries of hermitian spaces, and decomposing unitary groups into compact, diagonal and unipotent parts.

label: Dirichlet L-functions, quadratic twists
gloss: Facts about Dirichlet L-functions: functional equation via theta series, Gauss sums, Landau's lemma, and a prime with zero-free quadratic twists.

label: Prime number theorem in progressions
gloss: Counts primes in arithmetic progressions, using growth of Dirichlet L-functions near the line Re s = 1 and a Tauberian theorem.

label: Complex multiplication and Chowla–Selberg
gloss: Elliptic curves with complex multiplication: their lattices, Galois conjugates, good reduction, and the Kronecker and Chowla–Selberg formulas.

label: Formal groups of CM curves
gloss: The formal group of an elliptic curve with complex multiplication: integral power series describing the group law near zero.

label: Integrality of CM theta expansions
gloss: Shows Taylor expansions of theta functions on CM elliptic curves have integral coefficients and integral values at torsion points.

label: Weierstrass sigma and theta functions
gloss: The classical sigma and Weierstrass functions of a lattice in the complex plane, and theta functions of CM elliptic curves.

label: Grunwald's theorem
gloss: Builds cyclic field extensions of prime degree with prescribed behaviour at finitely many primes.

label: ℓ-adic avatars of Hecke characters
gloss: Turns algebraic Hecke characters into ℓ-adic Galois characters and checks they match locally, including under base change.

label: Continuous Galois cohomology
gloss: Cohomology of Galois groups with discrete coefficients: cocycles, Shapiro's lemma, cup products, Kummer theory and index formulas.

label: Global class field theory
gloss: Global class field theory: the Artin map, reciprocity, norm theorems, the existence theorem and Chebotarev's density theorem.

label: Greenberg–Wiles Selmer counting
gloss: Counts the size of Selmer groups of Galois modules through relations at split primes, in the style of Greenberg and Wiles.

label: Hecke characters of CM fields
gloss: Hecke characters of CM fields and of the norm-one group U(1): existence with given weight, their values and ramification.

label: Hecke L-functions
gloss: L-functions of Hecke characters of number fields: Euler products, densities of primes, and analytic behaviour at s = 1.

label: Local class field theory
gloss: Local class field theory: the invariant of the Brauer group of a local field and the local Artin map.

label: Local Tate duality
gloss: Duality between Galois cohomology groups of a local field, including a version for crystalline cocycles.

label: Places, decomposition and ideles
gloss: Basic vocabulary of algebraic number theory: places, decomposition and inertia groups, Frobenius elements, local fields and ideles.

label: Étale-type cohomology and Woods Hole
gloss: Cohomology theories of varieties with torsion coefficients, base change, and a Woods Hole fixed point formula with an overview of the theory.

label: Étale cohomology via functors
gloss: Cohomology of varieties built as Ext groups of functors on rings, with comparison, continuity and excision results.

label: Hodge cohomology and fixed points
gloss: Hodge cohomology of smooth varieties with products, the class of the diagonal and a fixed point formula.

label: Hodge–Tate classes of points
gloss: Shows the Hodge–Tate map keeps classes of points on projective varieties nonzero and linearly independent.

label: Projective line formula
gloss: Computes the cohomology of the projective line and the Chern class of O(1) for several coefficient theories.

label: Proper base change
gloss: Proper base change for cohomology with ℤ/ℓ coefficients over absolutely integrally closed valuation rings.

label: Stickelberger and odd class groups
gloss: Cyclotomic field arithmetic: Stickelberger ideals, Gauss sums, and a uniform bound on the odd part of a Tate–Shafarevich-type group.

label: Kolyvagin derivative classes
gloss: Kolyvagin's method: build cohomology classes from Gauss sums and use reciprocity laws to bound class groups.

label: Cusp kernels on unitary groups
gloss: Shows certain convolution kernels on real unitary groups kill bounded functions invariant under a unipotent radical.

label: Bessel models of U(p,q)
gloss: Bessel functions on real unitary groups, the Haar measures of their unipotent subgroups, and L² bounds.

label: Bruhat decomposition and floor measures
gloss: Decompositions of split unitary groups into cells and floors, with the measures on them at real and complex places.

label: Discrete series characters
gloss: Characters, K-type multiplicities and formal degrees of discrete series of real unitary groups via orbital integrals.

label: Flensted-Jensen discrete series construction
gloss: Constructs discrete series matrix coefficients of U(p,q) as integrals and proves they are square-integrable Casimir eigenfunctions.

label: Haar measure on unitary groups
gloss: Explicit Haar measures on unitary groups via the Cayley chart and coordinates from Gram matrices.

label: Holomorphic discrete series
gloss: Holomorphic discrete series of unitary groups, their model functions, and where bounded holomorphic forms reach their maximum.

label: Rigidity of highest weight vectors
gloss: Shows vectors of a given highest K-type in a unitary representation of U(p,q) are pinned down by Casimir bounds.

label: Local theta correspondence
gloss: The local theta correspondence for real unitary dual pairs, via harmonic polynomials in the Fock model.

label: Duality of GL(n) representations
gloss: Duals of integral polynomial representations of GL(n), mixed weights and the Cartan product.

label: Branching from GL(n+1) to GL(n)
gloss: Restricting representations of GL(n+1) to GL(n) × GL(1): explicit branching maps that keep integrality, with norm bounds.

label: Schur and Weyl modules
gloss: Polynomial representations of GL(n) as Schur and Weyl modules: bases of minors, Gram matrices and norm bounds.

label: Taylor–Wiles places, weight congruences
gloss: Auxiliary Taylor–Wiles places, ℓ-adic models of forms with congruences changing the weight, and polynomials killing Frobenius.

label: Cyclic base change, unitary groups
gloss: Transferring eigenforms on definite unitary groups along cyclic extensions of prime degree using a twisted trace identity.

label: Hilbert 90 for matrix groups
gloss: Versions of Hilbert's Theorem 90 for general linear and unitary groups over finite, Artinian and profinite rings.

label: Local-global compatibility at split places
gloss: Checks that Galois representations attached to forms match the local behaviour of the forms at split places.

label: Galois representations of unitary eigenforms
gloss: Attaches ℓ-adic Galois representations to Hecke eigenforms on definite unitary groups of every rank.

label: Pseudorepresentations and traces
gloss: Semisimple representations are determined by their traces; pseudorepresentations and limits of traces.

label: General combinatorics and topology
gloss: Small general lemmas: the q-binomial theorem, Schur polynomials, open subgroups and images of ℓ-adic characters.

label: Commutative algebra toolkit
gloss: General commutative algebra: completions, Fitting ideals, lengths, long exact sequences, power series and perfect rings.

label: Fourier analysis and integral estimates
gloss: Real and complex analysis lemmas: Fourier transforms, Gaussian integrals, parameter integrals and Sobolev-type bounds.

label: Schemes via functors of points
gloss: Schemes described by their points over rings: line bundles, projective embeddings, étale charts and Galois covers.

label: Matrix groups and finite characters
gloss: Integral and congruence matrix groups, block triangular subgroups, and characters of finite and profinite groups.

label: Matrix analysis and integral matrices
gloss: Linear algebra lemmas: determinants and minors, hermitian matrices, eigenvalues, integral matrices and norm estimates.

label: Haar measure and integration
gloss: Measure theory lemmas: Haar measure normalisation, pushforwards, integral operators and measures on hermitian quadrics.

label: Number fields and CM fields
gloss: Number field basics: CM fields, differents, imaginary quadratic fields, units and class numbers, and ℓ-adic coefficient rings.

label: Spherical Hecke polynomial roots
gloss: Chains of roots of the Hecke polynomial of a spherical vector for GL(n) over a local field.

label: Green's characters of GL_n(F_q)
gloss: Characters of general linear groups over finite fields, after Green, built with the Hall algebra of class functions.

label: Iwahori Hecke operators for GL_n
gloss: Hecke operators at Iwahori and pro-p Iwahori level for GL(n) over a local field, and their eigenvalue exponents.

label: Shintani descent over finite fields
gloss: Shintani descent: relates characters of GL(n) over a finite field and over its extensions of prime degree.

label: Crystalline comparison and Frobenius
gloss: Shows p-adic cohomology of proper schemes is crystalline, with completion and tilting tools for the comparison.

label: Crystalline comparison theorem
gloss: The crystalline comparison theorem, built from divided power envelopes and checked on étale charts.

label: Almost v-descent and tilting
gloss: Descent for p-adic test rings: tilting, Fontaine's map and almost v-descent for perfect algebras.

label: Alexander duality for compared cohomology
gloss: Integration over the projective line and duality results such as excision and Alexander duality for compared cohomology theories.

label: Hodge–Tate map and weights
gloss: Constructs the Hodge–Tate map on p-adic cohomology and reads off Hodge–Tate weights of the Galois action.

label: Primitive comparison theorem
gloss: The primitive comparison theorem for p-adic cohomology with period coefficients, giving finiteness of p-adic cohomology.

label: Tate–Sen theory and Bloch–Kato
gloss: Core p-adic Hodge theory facts: Tate's vanishing theorem, Bloch–Kato crystalline classes, and p-adic Hecke characters.

label: Crystalline representations
gloss: Crystalline and potentially crystalline Galois representations, admissibility, and Hodge–Tate weights under operations on representations.

label: Kisin modules
gloss: Kisin modules over power-series charts in A_inf, period matrices of crystalline lattices, and the frame theorem.

label: Limits of crystalline representations
gloss: Shows limits of crystalline representations with bounded Hodge–Tate weights keep their local conditions.

label: Fontaine's period rings
gloss: Fontaine's period rings A_inf, the crystalline rings and B_dR, the map θ, and Ax's theorem on Galois invariants in ℂ_p.

label: Hecke eigenquotients and theta structures
gloss: Galois representations cut out of cohomology by Hecke eigenvalues, and theta structures on abelian schemes.

label: Abelian schemes and isogenies
gloss: Abelian schemes over a base: base change, isogenies, pairings of line bundles and coordinates near the identity.

label: Theta functions on complex tori
gloss: Theta functions on complex tori: Appell–Humbert data, factors of automorphy and the dimension of spaces of theta functions.

label: Eichler–Shimura congruence relation
gloss: The congruence relation at split places: Hecke operators on the reduction of a Shimura variety match Frobenius.

label: Deformations and tangent spaces
gloss: Bounds the tangent space of a moduli scheme of abelian varieties using first-order deformations over dual numbers.

label: Good reduction of theta tori
gloss: Shows certain complex tori defined by theta functions have good reduction, by bounding theta values at torsion points.

label: Hecke operators on Kuga–Sato towers
gloss: Hecke operators at split places acting on a tower of Kuga–Sato varieties, with levels and torsion counts.

label: Integral models of Shimura varieties
gloss: Builds integral models of moduli spaces of abelian varieties with PEL structure, as a tower of Kuga–Sato covers.

label: Theta-coordinate moduli of abelian schemes
gloss: Moduli of polarised abelian schemes embedded in projective space by theta functions, and existence of a universal family.

label: Riemann theta relation and reduction
gloss: Integral theta functions of abelian varieties, Riemann's theta relation and their behaviour under reduction at a valuation.

label: Definite trace formula comparison
gloss: A trace formula for algebraic forms on definite unitary groups, compared with orbit sums from the Shimura variety side.

label: Lefschetz transfer of Hecke eigensystems
gloss: Uses a Lefschetz fixed point count to show which Hecke eigensystems appear in the cohomology of a Shimura variety.

label: Complex uniformisation of abelian varieties
gloss: Complex abelian varieties as tori, period maps from adelic frames, and the complex ball model of the moduli points.

label: Hermitian lattice masses and neighbours
gloss: Masses of definite hermitian lattices, neighbouring lattices, and a reproducing formula for Fock vectors by theta lifts.

label: Siegel–Weil formula
gloss: The Siegel–Weil formula for split hermitian spaces in Weil's convergent range, relating theta integrals to Eisenstein series.

label: Siegel's formula and local densities
gloss: Siegel's formula for numbers of representations by hermitian lattices, through local densities at finite places.

label: Rallis inner product formula
gloss: The Rallis inner product formula by the doubling method: norms of theta lifts as L-values, and injectivity of the lift.

label: Fourier coefficients and singular forms
gloss: Fourier coefficients of automorphic forms along a unipotent radical, and singular forms controlled by few coefficients.

label: Theta tower and constant terms
gloss: Constant terms of theta integrals in a tower of unitary groups, Tate integrals, and the functional equation of character L-functions.

label: Vacuum coefficients and Rallis series
gloss: Coefficients of the spherical vacuum vector under neighbour steps, and a series of translates weighted by them.

label: Theta lifts and the seesaw
gloss: Theta lifts of forms between spaces, tame local Gauss sums, and the seesaw identity for periods.

label: Definite unitary theta lifts
gloss: Theta lifts between unitary groups of definite hermitian spaces, given by jets of theta functions acting on algebraic forms.

label: Adelic Weil representation
gloss: Construction of the adelic Weil representation from the Heisenberg group, with its theta functional and Fourier inversion.

label: Unitary dual pairs, theta kernels
gloss: Dual pairs of unitary groups: the Weil action of the pair, theta kernels, their decay and convergence of theta lifts.

label: Fock model of Weil representation
gloss: The Fock model of the Weil representation at a real place: polynomial vectors, inner products and matrix coefficients.

label: Mixed Schrödinger models
gloss: Mixed models of the Weil representation along isotropic splittings, used to compute constant terms of theta functions.

label: Bessel periods of theta integrals
gloss: Unfolding theta integrals over Bessel subgroups, constant terms of Weil functions and vanishing of theta descents.

label: Unramified Hecke operators, theta lifts
gloss: Hecke operators at unramified places for GL(n) and unitary groups, and how Hecke polynomials pass through theta lifts.

label: From non-vanishing to RH
gloss: Final step: no zeros with real part above one half implies all nontrivial zeros lie on the critical line.

label: Periods of discrete series coefficients
gloss: Lower bounds for periods of discrete series matrix coefficients over subgroups, by Laplace's method when weights are far apart.

label: Regular families of twists exist
gloss: States that suitable families of character twists exist, as the conclusion of the Selmer group argument in this folder.

label: Ribet's method to first order
gloss: Bounds congruence numbers by building Galois cohomology classes from congruent Galois representations, in the style of Ribet.

label: Conjugate self-dual Galois representations
gloss: Galois representations attached to the forms in the argument, and the hypotheses they satisfy for the Selmer bounds.

label: Lifting crystalline extension classes
gloss: p-adic Hodge theory estimates for extension classes of crystalline representations in large weight, using Kisin modules.

label: Crystalline local conditions above ℓ
gloss: Measures how much is lost at places above ℓ when Galois cohomology classes are required to be crystalline.

label: Selmer groups of anticyclotomic twists
gloss: Shows many anticyclotomic character twists have small Selmer groups, using Stickelberger systems and reciprocity at conjugate primes.

label: Divisibility of theta jets
gloss: Shows high derivatives of theta functions are divisible by many primes, with exponents matching a weighted prime count.

label: The CM field K(ζ)
gloss: The specific CM field E = K(ζ) used in the proof: how primes split, its different, and characters of given weight.

label: Formal group and theta products
gloss: Uses the formal group of a CM elliptic curve to control the p-adic shape of theta function products at non-split primes.

label: Sharpness of valuation bound
gloss: Shows the divisibility bound for derivatives of theta functions is attained, prime by prime.

label: Integral vacuum of Weil representation
gloss: An integral normalisation of the vacuum vector of the Weil representation, with bounds on its theta values and their jets.

label: Auxiliary forms via grid paths
gloss: Constructs auxiliary forms by moving periods of theta lifts step by step along paths through two grids of spaces.

label: Norms of theta lift chains
gloss: Computes the determinant of a chain of theta lifts as a product of determinants of single lifts.

label: Exchange identity for theta integrals
gloss: An identity relating theta integrals over unitary groups of complementary rank, up to constants given by L-values.

label: Norms of theta lifts
gloss: The theta lift from a definite space, its adjoint and its norm, with values in a weight representation.

label: Theorem C: long integral forms
gloss: Ratios of twisted to untwisted Hecke L-values, and the lower bound saying integral forms have large norm.

label: Cost of one theta lift
gloss: Height bound for the ratio of determinants of one theta lift with and without a twist.

label: Comparison operator and gluing
gloss: Builds an operator from three exchanges of theta integrals and shows products of theta kernels span the good forms.

label: Periods of false lifts vanish
gloss: Shows that forms orthogonal to theta lifts have vanishing periods, through a tower of vanishing theta descents.

label: Hecke L-values as theta norms
gloss: Writes Hecke L-values as squared norms of theta lifts of characters, and bounds their algebraic parts and heights.

label: Main inequality and one-sided bound
gloss: Combines Theorems A, B and C into the main inequality and derives a one-sided bound on prime sums.

label: Admissible data and parameters
gloss: Fixes the parameters of the proof: the CM field, its places, ranks, weights, level and twists, and bounds their sizes.

label: Heights and twisted lattices
gloss: Heights of families of numbers over all places, colengths of modules, and lattices with one map per twist.

label: Prime sums and L-function zeros
gloss: Relates weighted prime sums to zeros of L-functions: a one-sided bound on the error excludes zeros from a half-plane.

label: Bessel functions at real places
gloss: Bessel functions on real unitary groups: normalisation, decay, cutoffs and L² bounds needed for the second moment.

label: Local orbital integrals over frames
gloss: Local estimates at one place for integrals over pairs of frames, which bound densities in the second moment.

label: Main term: sieve, Kloosterman sums
gloss: Bounds the main term of the second moment with Poisson summation, Kloosterman sums and a sieve over places.

label: Equal multiplicities of Hecke eigensystems
gloss: Each Hecke eigensystem occurs with the same multiplicity on two unitary groups that differ only in signs at real places.

label: Remaining terms via lattice counts
gloss: Bounds the off-diagonal terms of the second moment by counting lattices and frames of small discriminant.

label: Second moment and spanning theorem
gloss: Shows translates of Poincaré series span the target forms, from a second-moment estimate.

label: Unfolding Poincaré series
gloss: Unfolds inner products of Poincaré series into sums of terms and proves the second-moment bounds from them.

label: Divisibility of the composite lift
gloss: Shows the composite theta lift is divisible by large powers of each prime, place by place.

label: Elementary divisors of Hecke operators
gloss: Bounds the elementary divisors of a Hecke operator on lattice functions, showing few forms are only weakly divisible.

label: Theta kernel jets and bounds
gloss: Galois conjugates, integrality and archimedean size bounds for jets of theta kernels between definite spaces.

label: Source forms, target forms, chains
gloss: Defines the main objects of the upper bound: spaces of forms, chains of theta lifts and the Poincaré map.

label: Seesaw identity for lift chains
gloss: An iterated seesaw identity writes a chain of theta lifts of Poincaré series as a combination of simpler lifts.

label: Size of the composite lift
gloss: Bounds the archimedean size of the composite lift and shows short forms span the ramified source forms.
